hypothesis: Two hashed value-embedding tables on the last VE layer improve fresh public-20M BPB over an exact c5c no-table control on the same host within the 1800-second full-chip budget.
single_causal_change: Replace --no-ngram-ve with the queue's A1 last-layer bigram+trigram, mult64, dim128, BF16 RMSProp table profile; all other c5c control flags and source bytes remain identical.

candidate_shortlist.why_ranked: Higher capacity and cost; not the single-factor A1 gate and requires its own exact-size evidence.
Explains repeated-data effects but does not itself establish a table benefit.
Blocked until exact table semantics and native training work; previous source candidate was rejected.

selection_rationale: A1 is the smallest full-size table arm in the approved queue and a prerequisite for scaling tables; perform correctness gates before spending a full run.
trainium_feasibility: The six-layer, width-1024, world-4/LNC2 source selects last VE layer 5. A1 creates b5 and t5, each 524288 x 128 BF16 entries (128 MiB each), plus replicated gradients and RMSProp second moments. Ownership must continue for AdamW/Muon while RMSProp is replicated. Native compilation, HBM, full-step throughput and disk footprint are unverified; neither host is launch-ready at package time.
cheapest_falsifier: After host recovery, exact c5c four-rank CPU/G2 two-step --trace-rmsprop at mult64/dim128. Reject on wrong table count, missing RMSProp calls, divergent ranks, nonfinite traces, bad update recomputation or strict-load failure before any Neuron job.

success_criteria.quality: Fresh-process public-20M/context1024 delta against same-host valid c5c control <= -0.0006 nominates for a cross-host replicate. Two-host adoption requires both deltas negative, mean <= -0.0010, disagreement <= 0.0015, and human acknowledgement. A delta <= -0.010 or score < 0.975 triggers HOLD and an independent cold replay/audit.
success_criteria.throughput: Record completed steps, training seconds, steady-state ms/step and tok/s; if steps differ by >10% from the same-host control, mark CONFOUNDED rather than a quality verdict.
success_criteria.correctness: Exact c5c G2 trace PASS, independent native 30-step smoke PASS, full-chip LNC2/world4 seed42, finite 1800-second result, strict model-only checkpoint load, pure causal/batch-independent eval, clean source/host/postflight, and retrieved log plus fresh public-20M evaluation.

abort_conditions: Either host disk/breaker remains blocked; trn21 has no valid same-host c5c A0 control or host-specific G1 receipt
Exact c5c/m64/dim128 A1 G2 receipt and independent verification are missing or fail
Native 30-step smoke fails, omits step/table evidence, or is not fully quiescent
Pre-run free space is below the unchanged 6.5-GiB floor plus a newly measured conservative table/cache/checkpoint allowance
Any crash, NaN, causality error, budget violation, dirty source tree, missing checkpoint or descendant/device holder
